ValidationRule.description: Taking a booklet out of circulation is an auditable act; the reason must be recorded on the passport itself.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Lost"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Surrendered") ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Cancellation_Reason__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a Cancellation Reason when the passport status is Cancelled, Lost or Surrendered.
